leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a test suite for the useFetch composable using Vue Test Utils
Configure mock responses for different HTTP status codes in useFetch tests
Manipulate component state to simulate loading and error scenarios
Construct assertions that verify data fetching behavior and error handling
Integrate test utilities to simulate user interactions with fetched data
Initialize test environments with proper mocks for network requests
Apply testing patterns to validate reactive updates from useFetch
